title: Nuevo Laredo: Water Work to Close a Lane on César López de Lara on Monday
excerpt: A lane of Avenida César López de Lara in Nuevo Laredo will close Monday, Nov. 23, for water infrastructure work, and seven colonias could see low pressure or a temporary water shutoff of up to six hours.
content:
A lane of Avenida César López de Lara in Nuevo Laredo will close on Monday, Nov. 23, for water infrastructure work, and seven colonias could see low pressure or a temporary water shutoff, according to the city's Public Works department.

Starting at 10:00 a.m., one lane of the avenue will remain closed between Anáhuac and Toluca streets while crews connect and install a valve, the Secretaría de Obras Públicas y Desarrollo Urbano said.

The work is expected to last about eight hours. During that time, the colonias México, Jardín, Campestre, Electricistas, Infonavit, Anáhuac and Los Encinos could register low pressure or a temporary suspension of drinking water service for up to six hours.

Residents in those areas are advised to take precautions, store enough water and consider alternate routes. The work is intended to strengthen the water infrastructure and improve the operation of the drinking water distribution network.

Source: Gobierno de Nuevo Laredo, Secretaría de Obras Públicas y Desarrollo Urbano, Nov. 21, 2026.
